FusionAI gene-fusion-breakpoint classification from the published Nucleotide Transformer v2 500M multi-species layer-20 middle-token embeddings (Zenodo 18713246). The two 1024-d partner embeddings are concatenated into 2048 features for 51859 rows (25956 fusion-positive, 25903 pseudo-negative). Only NT middle embeddings are fetched from the multi-model archive. Connected components of rows sharing an exact partner embedding are kept within folds. Negatives are pseudo-fusions assembled from genes not known to participate in fusions, so performance must be interpreted as discrimination under this benchmark construction rather than prospective breakpoint detection.
